g.text: NOW: NS-4 — measuring how many reports it takes to cover a diverse family now that the floor means something
flaw fixed: floor from automated clusters
• NS-1 baseline (5-fold held-out): AUC 0.959 · real damped 99.4% (×0.896) · noise ×0.783
• NS-2+3: AUC 0.984 · every hit scored in one space · e2e caught 2 bugs (space mismatch, unordered k-means seed)
• NS-4: floor 0.55 → calibrated 0.772 · real damped 97% → 5% · noise still 94% · 4/6 hard negatives untouched
• NS-4 e2e caught a design flaw: recalibrating after a report cancelled it (6/37) → floor now set by automated clusters only
• Reports vs coverage of a 1,718-run family: 1 → 14% · 5 → 67% · 20 → 76% · 100 → 82% damped
• Reporting what search shows: 24/32 of that neighbourhood demoted; real-topic results 77% untouched, rest ≥ ×0.94
• 42 persona sessions unflagged (pre-#145); ~2,700 templated agent runs the classifier doesn't know
• FTS slowness: planner misestimate → per-session to_tsvector on ~920k msgs; MATERIALIZED rewrite 60.6s → 47ms
yellow = active green = merge-ready grey = waiting red = blocked
Where sessions sit: similarity to nearest noise cluster (NS-1 baseline)
red = held-out noise (n=1591) blue = real sessions (n=500) AUC 0.959
everything right of it is damped
After NS-2: corpus = automated + useless sessions' own summary vectors
AUC 0.959 → 0.984 · held-out noise p10 0.740 → 0.801 · real sessions still 97% damped (floor fix = NS-4)
reported useless). Each one is scored against
clusters built WITHOUT it, so it stands in for
coding sessions nothing marks as noise.
x-axis = cosine similarity to the NEAREST noise
bar height = share of that colour in the bin.
The goal: damp red, spare blue.
Any result right of the floor line gets damped,
so the floor belongs in the gap between the humps
(~0.77), not at 0.55 where it catches everything.
After NS-4: floor calibrated from real sessions (95th percentile)
real sessions damped 97.4% → 5.0% · held-out noise still 94% damped · 4 of 6 hard negatives untouched
What did you do to cause the line to move?
A: the bars barely changed — the LINE moved.
NS-2 and NS-4 plot almost the same data. What changed
• 0.55 (dashed grey) is left of BOTH humps → damps everything
• NS-4 sets it at the 95th percentile of the blue hump → 0.772,
in the gap between the humps
Only results right of the red line get damped:
94% of red, 5% of blue. The line recalibrates itself
on a local copy of its data
